extraction_notes: Fig. 3 SS15-SS16 dashed curve was sampled directly from the supplied vector plot at Tj=25 degC, pulse width=300 us, and 1% duty cycle; no intermediate points were synthesized. Fig. 4 SS12-SS16 solid curves explicitly include SS16. Reverse-current values are represented as positive magnitudes in the plotted mA axis.

The electrical-characteristics table gives maximum VF=0.70 V at IF=1.0 A for the SS15-SS16 group; maximum IR1=0.5 mA at VR=VDC=60 V and Ta=25 degC for the SS12-SS16 group; separate maximum IR2=50 mA at VR=VDC and Ta=100 degC for the SS12-SS16 group; and typical CJ=90 pF at 4.0 V DC and 1 MHz for the SS15-SS120 group. IR2 is not used as the reverse-current fit target.

Absolute-rating bounds for SS16 are VRRM=60 V, VRMS=42 V, VDC=60 V, IF(AV)=1.0 A, and IFSM=30 A at t=8.3 ms half-sine wave, Ta=25 degC. Junction temperature and storage temperature are each bounded from -55 to +150 degC inclusive as printed on p. 1. These are limits, not fitted curve points.

The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time specification and no breakdown-voltage or breakdown-current specification; VRRM and VDC ratings are not treated as breakdown data. Fig. 1 derating and Fig. 2 surge-current plots are rating curves and are omitted from the compact DC curve set.
